rows.name: Opal Grand Ocean Front Resort & Spa

pet_sentences: Whether you’re planning a romantic getaway, a long-awaited celebration, or a family beach vacation, each accommodation offers a (dog-friendly) peaceful respite.
Dog Policy We welcome well-mannered dogs.

Guests bringing dogs must always have them leashed when outside the guestroom and will be charged a non-refundable fee disclosed at the time of booking per night, per dog; maximum of two dogs per room.
Guests will be responsible for any property damage inadvertently caused by their dogs.
Housekeeping service during your stay should be arranged either when you and your dog are not in the room or if you are, the dog must be leashed or crated.
Service dogs are welcome at the hotel and are not subject to the policies and restrictions described above.
Under the ADA, a service dog is defined as a dog that has been individually trained to do work or perform tasks for an individual with a disability.
The task(s) performed by the dog must be directly related to the person’s disability.
Please note emotional support and anxiety relief dogs do not qualify under the ADA guidelines of a service dog and are subject to our policy above.
Does the hotel allow pets in the rooms?
Our pet-friendly Florida resort welcomes well-mannered dogs (up to 2 dogs per room).
Our pet fee is $100 per night, per dog.
For more information on our dog policy please click here .

We understand your dogs are more than just companions; they are members of your family.
As a dog-friendly resort, you’ll soon discover that we cater to your dogs with the same level of exceptional personalized service you’ve come to appreciate and expect as one of our guests.

Our pet policy permits a maximum of two (2) dogs per guestroom or cottage, per stay and should not exceed 50 pounds each, provided they are fully trained, kept on a leash at all times, and complies with local legislation laws and requirements.

Pet Policy Form For the safety and comfort of all our guests, we kindly ask that you review and agree to the following guidelines: A non-refundable $150* dog fee will be added to guest’s room account.

PGA National Resort is willing to accommodate dogs up to 50 pounds (service dogs excluded), provided they are fully trained, kept on a leash at all times, and comply with the local legislation laws and requirements.
All pet waivers must be signed either at check-in or prior to arrival.
Are pets allowed?
At PGA National Resort, we welcome dogs and service dogs alike.
Please note: Dogs must meet size restrictions and cannot be left in your room alone.
If a dog is in the room, your room attendant will not enter, so you may need to make alternate arrangements for room cleaning.
